context: V1 — profiled for diffing against BurnerV2 only.
purpose: V1 dispatcher that burns the prime token received per mint and records it in BurnRecorder. Identical economic behavior to BurnerV2; the only structural difference is V1 overrides external dispatch() directly (no internal _dispatch, no hook, no nonReentrant).
diffVsV2: V1 overrides external dispatch() with modifiers inline; V2 moves logic to internal _dispatch and adds the post-dispatch hook + nonReentrant on the base dispatch.

externalCalls.notes: Must be authorized burner on the recorder.

valueFlows: DISPATCH: prime token burned (supply down), amount recorded. No third-party transfer.
invariants: Each mint burns actualReceived; recorder.totalBurnt grows by that amount.
trustAssumptions: _token is IBurnable; dispatcher authorized on recorder; non-FOT token.
